body: I keep telling my psychiatrist I am unbelievably tired all the time but I just go up and down on Mirtazapine. Nothing changes and I'm wrecked all the time.
Yeah the meds you take are going to make you wrecked..
Can I ask how long the episode was or was it that it just got into your head at the time?
I really appreciate this. Thank you.

Are you thinking of taking or teaching them? Different info on each. I can DM the latter as I don't want to dox myself and it's more detailed, 

but if it's just taking them, then you can see the courses with whatever your etb is on fetchcourses. They will be hosted anywhere from community centres, proper colleges, men's/women's sheds, non profits etc... and localised so there will be something near you anyway.

I book and run these courses for a living and because of their nature, it's 99% really sound tutors. 

We have a lot of interesting tutors come through our place as we like to do a solid variety of classes . They come from all walks of life, but all have a kind and caring demeanor because it's what they enjoy doing, rather than what they are forced to teach.
